label: late original-phase positions (t=5-8), strongest when sequence starts with t
explanation: Sparse feature (0.3% of steps). Fires only on late original-phase inputs (orig_idx 5-8, 97% of mass; peaks at orig_idx 7, usually the last or second-to-last token before <DEL>), with a small tail on the <DEL> step (3% of mass). It never fires at t<=3 or in the copy phase. Even at those positions only about 3% of steps are active, so position alone gives very low precision (recall 0.95). The strongest single modulator is the first original token being t (12x lift, about half the mass, and the top activations all start with t). Input token 2 (7x) and previous token i (7x) also raise rates and magnitudes, and longer L raises the rate. Restricting to sequences starting with t gives F1 of about 0.30 on dev. Adding in_tok==2 or prev_tok==i as alternatives raises mass recall to 0.80, but precision drops to 0.17. What actually triggers it looks like a diffuse conjunction over token history that no simple predicate captures.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=t (+6.28), prev_tok=i (+4.32), t=7 (+3.77), orig0=a (+3.30), prev_tok=h (+3.13), t=6 (+2.97). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-6.38), t=4 (-5.57), phase=2 (-5.42), orig0=h (-4.09).
